messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: inference-streaming.p99 breach detected across multiple regions. p95 jumped to ~900ms, p99 spiked to ~2400ms for model variant redwood-llm-int8-calib-v5. Pattern: streaming stalls and long tail on requests >1024 tokens. Auto-paging oncall.

alice (oncall): I'm on it — acknowledging. Anyone in eng-runtime/eng-ml around? Putting an initial triage doc in #incidents-wiki.

bob (eng-runtime): here, looking. First glance at metrics: see big p99 jump at 2299001000 across us-east/us-west. Request QPS steady. Looks like latency, not increased load.

carla (eng-ml): fyi we rolled out a calibration profile (calib-v5) for int8 yesterday to reduce token cost. I suspect calibration fallout -> dequant path stress + KV cache churn for long contexts. Could cause stalls on streaming if kv cache invalidation frequency increased.

alice (oncall): good context. Can you confirm which model ids and rollout ids? we need an immediate mitigation plan.

carla (eng-ml): model name: redwood-llm, variant: int8-calib-v5, rollout id: rollout-20260314-07. Previous stable profile: int8-calib-v4 and fp16-stable.

bob (eng-runtime): extracting recent kernel traces and scheduling logs now. Sharing a monitoring query (Grafana/Datadog style):
```
avg(last_5m):p99(inference.latency) by {model_variant,region} where endpoint = "stream" and context_tokens > 1024
```
Seeing p99 2.4s for int8-calib-v5 vs 420ms for fp16-stable.

dave (sre): are we seeing any OOMs, GPU stalls, or host-level throttling? I checked node exporter and GPU metrics — no OOMs, but NVidia driver GPU_util shows occasional micro-stalls aligned with the spikes. Could be kernel code path oscillation.

carla (eng-ml): that matches suspicion: some quantized kernels hit a slow path for long sequences. We should avoid broad rollback of entire model fleet if we can scope it, but immediate customer impact mitigation needed. Options: 1) rollback calibration profile to int8-calib-v4, 2) route streaming traffic for long-context requests to fp16-stable, 3) throttle/limit max context for int8 variant temporarily. I recommend option 1 + canary.

alice (oncall): consensus lean toward rollback + canary for fastest recovery. Bob, can runtime do a canary rollback to v4 in us-east-1 1st?

bob (eng-runtime): yes. Starting canary rollback in us-east-1 (10% traffic) now. Command: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --model redwood-llm --from int8-calib-v5 --to int8-calib-v4 --region us-east-1 --canary 10`

bob (eng-runtime): executed. Canaries scheduled on healthy hosts, routing weights updated. I'll watch p99 in that region.

eve (cs): heads up — three paying customers are reporting elevated latency on live-chat. AcmeCorp and BetaApps show user-visible stalls. CS is drafting an incident notice. Impact: estimated 12% of streaming requests from paying customers experiencing >1s extra latency.

mike (product): tagging customer SLAs here. We need to surface impact to account team. Thanks.

alice (oncall): monitoring: p99 in us-east canary region trending down: from 2.3s -> 1.0s within 8 minutes after canary started. Still too high for SLO but improving.

dave (sre): good sign. I'll prepare a rollback runbook and reserve capacity in us-east in case rollback causes spike in memory footprint. Runbook snippet:
```
1) Initiate canary rollback (10%) -> monitor p99 and error_rate for 10m
2) If p99_down AND no infra alerts -> promote to 50% -> 10m -> 100%
3) If regression -> revert to v5 and route long-context to fp16-stable
```
Also opened host autoscale pre-warm for rollback.

carla (eng-ml): while we promote, I'll run regression tests on calibration edge cases (context > 4k tokens, streaming segmentation) and pull kernel flame graphs. Will prepare a patch for the quant kernel if needed.

bob (eng-runtime): promoting canary to 50% in us-east now. Command: `redwoodctl deploy promote --rollout-id rollout-20260314-07 --region us-east-1 --target 50`

alice (oncall): FYI I'm escalating to on-call lead for cross-region promotion if us-east holds. @dave please keep infra watch for any host-level anomalies.

dave (sre): infra steady so far. No new paging alerts.

eve (cs): sent interim status to impacted customers: "We've identified a latency regression following an int8 calibration update. We're running a controlled rollback to the previous calibration profile and expect improvements within 30 minutes. We'll update you as we validate full recovery." :email:

mike (product): mark this incident P1 for postmortem. Need root cause and mitigation playbook for calibration rollouts.

bob (eng-runtime): us-east 50% -> p99 550ms, 100% -> p99 460ms. Promoted to 100% in us-east. Rolling promotion to us-west now with canary 10%.

alice (oncall): handing off to bob for next hour; I'm going offline for another meeting but will check in. Bob, you're primary.

bob (eng-runtime): taking over. I'll coordinate cross-region promotions and final verification.

carla (eng-ml): summary action items I'm owning: 1) full rollback of int8-calib-v5 until quant kernel fix; 2) regression test matrix and perf benchmark for calib-v5; 3) postmortem writeup with root cause hypothesis (calibration-induced kernel slow-path for long-context dequant).

dave (sre): infra action items: 1) ensure autoscaling buffers for rollback, 2) add temporary circuit for routing long-context streams to fp16 if rollback fails, 3) add extra gpu telemetry alerts for micro-stalls.

eve (cs): CS will follow up with affected customers and track SLA burn. Current count: 3 customers with >5% session impact, 10 internal client teams reported.

bob (eng-runtime): us-west canary looks good; promoting to 100% across regions now. p99 cluster-wide falling back to baseline ~420-500ms. Removing paging alert once stable for 15m.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: RESOLVED (mitigation in progress): p99 returned within SLO in all regions after calibration-profile rollback to int8-calib-v4. Continue monitoring for 30m.

alice (oncall): thanks team. Post-incident follow-ups: schedule a canary runbook update, add a calibration rollback quick-run, and require perf validation baseline before rollout. Leaving final notes to postmortem.

carla (eng-ml): I'll open an internal RFC for safer calibration rollout (staged kernels, smaller sequence-length canaries).

mike (product): passing note to GTM and account teams. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
